role_description:
Damia Group is an international tech recruitment agency with 3 decades of experience. Our arrival in Portugal, 7 years later, was set on a mission to transform IT recruitment experiences and, through them, achieve better results. We believe in long-term relationships with a transparent and relaxed mindset. In a short period, we have reached the hearts of both scale-ups and larger organisations by delivering spot-on curated candidate shortlists, increased job offer acceptance rates and shorter time-to-fill.
Damia handles direct hires on behalf of our clients.
Every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo's Formula 1 Car, a Woolly Mammoth's Skeleton, Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt's running shoe, we encounter exceptional objects every day.

They are a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects! Each week they offer over 75,000 unique items in auction, carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.

Having sold over 20 million unique objects to date, they are on a mission to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, they proudly live by our core values: 

  • Taking ownership and driving impact 
  • Being open to change and feedback
  • Being passionate about our mission and our customers. 
If these values resonate with you, they would love to explore how you can join us on this exciting journey! 

 

How they work

As the biggest marketplace for special items, they operate in a domain that brings plenty of unusual challenges and opportunities. You will be developing, testing and scaling our microservices, mostly written in Ruby, to handle the high volume of requests served by the platform every single day. They do this by using Infrastructure as Code principles, collaborative peer reviews, Continuous Delivery, A/B testing every assumption and using the observability and monitoring tools already in place. They make mistakes and learn valuable lessons from them. Their focus is to be able to recover and iterate quickly.

What you’ll do   

You will make an impact by improving and delivering product innovations for their platform. Along with other members of the Development team, you will build scalable microservices while measuring and monitoring system performance. In addition, you will use experimentation, backed by data analysis, to add product features and deliver the best user experience on the platform.


Where you’ll be

This role is based in Lisbon, Portugal. They also offer an excellent relocation package for people living outside of Portugal. 

Their Offices and Way of Working

Their vibrant offices in Amsterdam, Paris and Lisbon are designed to inspire and connect. They are within commuting distance of one of our offices and enjoy the flexibility of a hybrid work model. This means that you will be in the office 2 out of 5 days (40% of your working time) to collaborate and connect with your colleagues. That said, some roles may be an exception: if the job description states that the position is fully remote or 100% office-based, that arrangement will apply instead.

role_description:
As a (Senior) Data Engineer, you will be the driving force behind the development and optimization of our cloud-based data platforms. Working at the intersection of business and technology, you will ensure that our data solutions are not only technically excellent but also provide real business value to our customers.

Using state-of-the-art technologies, you will develop robust data pipelines, ETL processes, and high-performance data models that enable scalable and efficient data utilization. Your goal: turning data into a strategic asset that empowers companies to make smarter decisions.

Your Responsibilities
  • Data Architecture & Development → Design and implementation of scalable data platforms using Microsoft Azure (Azure Data Lake, Azure SQL, Azure Synapse, Databricks)

  • ETL & Data Processing → Building, optimizing, and maintaining high-performance data pipelines with Databricks, Spark, and Kafka

  • Data Warehousing & Modeling → Developing robust data models and optimizing performance for efficient queries

  • Automation & CI/CD → Implementing CI/CD pipelines to automate deployments and testing

  • Collaboration with Business & Tech Teams → Close coordination with Data Scientists, Analytics Teams, and Business Stakeholders to develop data-driven solutions

  • Best Practices & Scalability → Ensuring our data solutions are sustainable, maintainable, and future-proof
